body:
Spec: .adlc/specs/install-experience.md (I4 section is binding). Depends on I2 (the universal install command it describes) and I1 (the skills.sh channel it describes).

=== CONTEXT ===
herdr's docs carry an "Or let your agent introduce you" section: framing copy, then a paste-able prompt ("Help me understand and set up Herdr. Read https://herdr.dev/agent-guide.md first, then walk me through it step by step."), backed by a ~1400-word served agent-guide.md addressed to the agent -- concept model, install, first-run walkthrough, diagnosis recipes, and a "Rules for you" section constraining agent behavior.

ADLC is a better fit for this pattern than most projects: the audience already runs an agent, and the site already exposes an LLM surface (apps/docs/app/llms.txt, llms-full.txt, llms.mdx routes).

CRITICAL DESIGN CONSTRAINT: the guide MUST be generated from integration-facts.mjs. A hand-written guide would be a SEVENTH copy of the per-harness install commands and would rot against the six that already exist. ADR-0009 Decision 4 (claim accuracy) applies -- we document only coverage a channel actually has.

=== TASK ===
1. Add apps/docs/lib/agent-guide.mjs that builds the guide body from INTEGRATIONS plus the UNIVERSAL_INSTALL constant. Sections: what ADLC is, the gate/phase concept model, detect-your-harness, install (universal first, native per-harness fallback), the skills.sh on-ramp with its limits, first-run walkthrough ending at `adlc init`, diagnosis recipes, and "Rules for you".
2. Add apps/docs/app/agent-guide.md/route.ts serving it as text/markdown.
3. Add an AGENT_PROMPT constant (single-source, alongside UNIVERSAL_INSTALL) and surface it on the /integrations index under an "Or let your agent introduce you" heading.
4. Link agent-guide.md from the llms.txt route so the existing LLM surface discovers it.
5. Add apps/docs/test/agent-guide.test.mjs covering the eight AC cases below.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC4.1: GET() returns 200, non-empty, text/markdown. VERIFY: `node --test apps/docs/test/agent-guide.test.mjs` route case passes.
- AC4.2: Every integration.install line of every INTEGRATIONS entry appears verbatim in the body. VERIFY: `node --test apps/docs/test/agent-guide.test.mjs` generation case passes.
- AC4.3: Body contains a detect-which-harness directive and names every integration.slug. VERIFY: `node --test apps/docs/test/agent-guide.test.mjs` detection case passes.
- AC4.4: Body contains a "Rules for you" section forbidding install commands before the human confirms. VERIFY: `node --test apps/docs/test/agent-guide.test.mjs` rules case passes.
- AC4.5: Body names the Node >= 18 prerequisite, states `adlc fleet` is POSIX-only, and describes skills.sh as "skills only". VERIFY: `node --test apps/docs/test/agent-guide.test.mjs` honesty case passes.
- AC4.6: AGENT_PROMPT is used on the /integrations index and its text contains the agent-guide.md URL. VERIFY: `node --test apps/docs/test/agent-guide.test.mjs` prompt case passes.
- AC4.7: The AGENT_PROMPT literal appears in no file under apps/docs/app/ or apps/docs/components/ other than its defining module. VERIFY: `node --test apps/docs/test/agent-guide.test.mjs` single-source case passes.
- AC4.8: The llms.txt route body links agent-guide.md. VERIFY: `node --test apps/docs/test/agent-guide.test.mjs` discovery case passes.
title: Agent-led onboarding: serve a generated agent-guide.md and a paste-able prompt that hands install to the user's agent
